Retain the local scope and the unresolved CAS/form requirement; inherited role assertions remain outside approval.

errata.original_reasoning: MediaDive616/DSMZ1113 names EMJH enrichment and100ml dosing, distinct from medium base. Albumin species and unspecified growth factors stay unresolved; BD product evidence is a comparator for partial composition, not proof of exact source catalog/version. Generic-family label suppression is defensible for this bounded owner under §§3/6.
errata.corrected_reasoning: Source mediadive.ingredient:992 is Leptospira Enrichment EMJH in DSMZ medium1113. The complete DSMZ recipe adds 100 mL enrichment to separately prepared EMJH base, agarose and water, establishing supplement scope distinct from the base. The captured BD manual supports an enrichment containing albumin, polysorbate80 and unspecified additional growth factors, while the source recipe does not establish an exact catalog/version or albumin species. The bounded source-qualified partial owner is supported within those limits. Making the unqualified family label non-resolving for this bounded owner is defensible under §§3/6; it is not a blanket rejection of named stock or product identities. No whole-owner/export approval follows.
